Definition: from G1223 and G1453; to wake fully; i.e. arouse (literally or figuratively):--arise, awake, raise, stir up.
BiblicalUsage: To wake up is to be stirred from sleep, and the word is used of storms and of souls. Jesus wakes and rebukes the wind on the lake, the disciples wake Him in fear, and Peter writes of stirring up pure minds by way of remembrance.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe waking is the work of Christ in every storm. The disciples woke Him in fear, and He woke the wind into stillness, and the same Lord still wakes drowsy hearts to remember what He has done.
